name: v0.3.57 — Mascot icon, Steals alerts, cleaner top bar
releaseNotes:
• New app icon — the GetGuac avocado in shades with cash, on the brand green.
• Steals has its own top-bar icon with a red badge counting fresh steals.
• Sign out is back in the top bar (slim button).
• Removed the “MONEY'S WINGMAN” tagline from the in-app top bar (it stays on the login screen) for a cleaner header.
